title: DTCR semantic document
description: One stored decision record, incident review, advisory, objective, telemetry baseline or prior refactor outcome, registered so that retrieval can rank it. Authority is fixed at NON_AUTHORITATIVE_CANDIDATE at the point of registration rather than at the point of retrieval, because a document that enters the store as context cannot later be re-read as a rule by whoever queries it. There is no body, excerpt, locator or URL key anywhere in this object: identity is a digest plus a back-reference identifier, so a private record is registered by reference from its own plane and its content is never copied into a public tree. A document whose visibility is private cannot declare the public tree as its storage plane, which is the ownership split written as a keyword rather than as a redaction step somebody performs on the way out. Free-text fields here are not shape-protected; they carry the leak-scan obligation in `contracts/public-private-capability.md` exactly as the other schemas' free text does.

document_digest.description: Content identity. A document that changed under the same title is a different document, and a store keyed by title never notices.

authority.description: Fixed at registration. Ranking answers which stored text resembles a query; it does not answer whether that text is current, whether it was superseded, or whether it ever bound this subsystem.

subsystem_tags.description: Which subsystems this document was about. Free text, and covered by the leak-scan obligation like every other free-text field here.

owning_decision.description: The decision this document belongs to. Free text under the same leak-scan obligation: no private locator, account identity or private file name belongs in it.

back_reference_ref.description: The exact back reference that says where this document came from. Registration without one produces an orphan row that retrieval will still happily return.

then.description: A private record stays in a private carrier or a consumer-local store. Registering it into the public tree is the copy this method exists to prevent, and it is prevented here rather than at publication time.

x-refusal-controls.refuses: A stored document registered as authoritative rather than as a retrieval candidate.
